parsed.main_gap: The stated locations of Liu’s marks do not produce the claimed binary interval lengths; replacing them by the cumulative sums fixes the proof.

errors.description: For interval lengths δ,2δ,…,2^nδ, the marks must be at (2^j−1)δ, not 2^jδ. The preceding sentence defines a valid strategy, so this is a localized, straightforwardly repairable error.
errors.quote: Thus his marks are \(2^j\delta\) for \(1\le j\le n\), all distinct and strictly inside the stick.

parsed.notes: Apart from this incorrect mark formula, the drafting lemma, refinement lemma, subset-sum upper bound, and matching binary lower bound form a coherent and essentially complete proof.
